deployment_feasibility.paragraph: Deployment requires specialty, gender, age, disability, appointment date/time/shift, companion and chronic-condition indicators, SMS status, and weather fields before each visit; place is omitted by the deployed no_place variant. The measured per-record model inference latency was 15.16 ms on this run. Retrain on a scheduled quarterly cadence or sooner when validated drift monitoring signals degradation; monitor calibration, flagged share, precision/recall, and forecast errors against fresh outcomes. Restrict health-data access, minimize retained fields, encrypt data in transit and at rest, and follow the clinic's privacy and consent requirements.
